g.title: wc3_customer_centered
g.text: The commerce flow from the customer's perspective

a.xlink:title: Sales proposal — forecast. on_p tracks weighted probability. Model: apps/transactions/models/proposal.py Functions: transfer_proposal_to_order @ apps/transactions/services/proposal_to_order.py:219 (converts proposal to order) Pending deltas: on_p: +qty_x_prob

Sales order — customer commitment. Creates +on_so and -on_p pending records. Model: apps/transactions/models/order.py Functions: transfer_proposal_to_order @ apps/transactions/services/proposal_to_order.py:219 (creates order from proposal) _create_transfer_pending_records @ apps/transactions/services/proposal_to_order.py:131 (pending records for +on_so, -on_p) Pending deltas: on_so: +qty, on_p: -qty

Purchase order to vendor. GAP: +on_po pending record is NOT created. Model: apps/transactions/models/purchase.py Functions: transfer_order_to_purchase @ apps/transactions/services/order_to_purchase.py:14 (creates PO from order) transfer_proposal_to_purchase @ apps/transactions/services/proposal_to_purchase.py:13 (creates PO from proposal) Pending deltas: on_po: +qty (GAP: not implemented — no Pending.objects.create)

Invoice — shipment event. Financial event triggers GL and inventory movement. Model: apps/transactions/models/invoice.py Functions: transfer_order_to_invoice @ apps/transactions/services/order_to_invoice.py:16 (creates invoice from order) Pending.objects.create @ apps/transactions/services/order_to_invoice.py:332 (-on_hand, -on_so, +on_in) Pending deltas: on_hand: -qty, on_so: -qty, on_in: +qty GL: AR debit, Revenue credit, Tax credit, COGS debit, Inventory credit, Commission
